purpose: Historical REFERENCE data derived from RAW exports, for human review and potential future import as MindBunker historical reference data. This is NOT MindBunker data, NOT native MindBunker work_sessions, and NOT manually backfilled canonical objects -- see ARTIFACT_CONTRACT.md for the three-tier distinction.

files.historical_facts_v0.json: Long-format quantitative fact records (period, identity, source, metric, value, unit, confidence, canonical, provenance, derivation).
files.identity_map_v0.json: Identity resolution nodes: HUMAN_CONFIRMED, SINGLE_SOURCE_ONLY, INTERNAL, NOT_AN_IDENTITY.
files.source_coverage_v0.json: Month-by-month presence/absence per source, Jan 2023 - Aug 2026.

warnings: activitywatch_afk facts with canonical=false or confidence='EXPERIMENTAL' must never be imported as worked hours, active hours, or MindBunker work_sessions.
client:sean_go 'tracked_hours_upper_bound' fact (canonical=false) must never be summed with 'tracked_hours_confident' or presented as an exact figure.
No fact in this artifact combines revenue from one source with hours from a different source into a cross-source rate. effective_billed_rate is Upwork-internal (Upwork revenue / Upwork hours) only.
